nodes.label: ReadSource
nodes.desc: Chooses the input source: --input channel, initial reload command, FZF_DEFAULT_COMMAND, directory walk, or plain stdin

nodes.label: feed
nodes.desc: Scans a reusable 128KB slab, splits lines (or NUL delimiters), pushes each record into the chunk list

nodes.label: readFiles
nodes.desc: Parallel directory walk via charlievieth/fastwalk with hidden and ignore-list filtering

nodes.label: startEventPoller
nodes.desc: Polls an atomic event flag on a back-off schedule (10ms to 50ms) and lifts EvtReadNew into the shared EventBox

nodes.label: Chunk
nodes.desc: Fixed-capacity [1024]Item array, the unit of work handed to matcher workers

nodes.label: ChunkList.Push
nodes.desc: Appends a new chunk when the last one is full; single mutex guard over the whole store

nodes.label: Snapshot
nodes.desc: Returns an immutable chunk slice, trims to --tail and duplicates boundary chunks so matchers never race the writer

nodes.label: ChunkCache
nodes.desc: Stores one 16-word bitmap per (chunk, query key); retired chunks drop their entries

nodes.label: Search prefix/suffix
nodes.desc: On cache miss, finds the longest cached prefix or suffix of the query so one keystroke reuses previous work

nodes.label: Item
nodes.desc: One input line packed into 56 bytes around a util.Chars value with an int32 index

nodes.label: BuildPattern
nodes.desc: Caches compiled patterns per query string, resolves smart-case and wires the six term matchers

nodes.label: parseTerms
nodes.desc: Extended-mode grammar: 'exact, ^prefix, suffix$, !inverse, equal and | OR terms

nodes.label: matchChunk
nodes.desc: Iterates chunk items, consulting and updating the cached bitmap of matching indexes

nodes.label: directAlgo fast path
nodes.desc: Single non-inverse fuzzy term bypasses the generic machinery and calls the algo function directly

nodes.label: extendedMatch
nodes.desc: AND over term sets with OR inside each set; sums term scores into the final rank

nodes.label: FuzzyMatchV2
nodes.desc: Modified Smith-Waterman dynamic program: four phases producing optimal alignment score and positions

nodes.label: FuzzyMatchV1
nodes.desc: O(n) greedy forward scan plus backward trim; also the fallback when V2 exceeds slab capacity

nodes.label: asciiFuzzyIndex
nodes.desc: Byte-level prefilter that narrows the DP window to the first and last occurrence of the pattern

nodes.label: fuzzyMatchV2Single
nodes.desc: Single ASCII character queries jump between occurrences without allocating score arrays

nodes.label: fuzzyMatchV2Two
nodes.desc: Two-character queries collapse DP rows 0 and 1 into scalar running state in one pass

nodes.label: bonusMatrix
nodes.desc: 16x16 char-class bonus table (boundary, camelCase, consecutive) plus ASCII fast lookup table

nodes.label: util.Slab
nodes.desc: Pre-allocated int16/int32 arenas reused across matches to keep the GC idle

nodes.label: Matcher.scan
nodes.desc: min(partitions, chunks) workers steal chunks from an atomic counter and radix-sort their local matches

nodes.label: mergerCache
nodes.desc: Memoizes the final Merger per query string while the item count is unchanged

nodes.label: Result.points
nodes.desc: Four uint16 slots packed in tiebreak order: score, chunk, length, begin/end

nodes.label: radixSortResults
nodes.desc: Stable LSD radix sort over the 64-bit rank key, O(n), with tac reversal for equal-key runs

nodes.label: compareRanks
nodes.desc: Casts points to a uint64 for a single comparison; item index breaks ties

nodes.label: Merger.mergedGet
nodes.desc: Lazily advances per-list cursors, always emitting the smallest remaining rank

nodes.label: Terminal.Loop
nodes.desc: Priority-sorted reqBox event loop for prompt, list, info, preview and quit requests

nodes.label: tui renderer
nodes.desc: Light ANSI renderer by default; tcell fullscreen renderer when available

nodes.label: UpdateList
nodes.desc: Swaps in the latest merger, preserves cursor tracking and schedules reqList repaint

nodes.label: byTimeOrder
nodes.desc: Accepted multi-selections are re-sorted by selection time, not by search relevance

nodes.label: Run coordinator
nodes.desc: Single-threaded event loop whose back-off sleep (10ms to 100ms) batches keystrokes between searches
